title: Ceigall India Ltd - 544223 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

summary.headline: Ceigall Q2 FY27 standalone PAT rose 46.7% to ₹82 crore on 23.8% revenue growth; order book ₹22,681 crore.
summary.overview: Standalone revenue grew 23.8% YoY to ₹974.5 crore in Q2 and EBITDA rose 42.3% to ₹130.5 crore, with margin up to 13.4% from 11.7%. Consolidated revenue grew 26.8% to ₹1,022.5 crore and consolidated EBITDA rose 53.2% to ₹174 crore (17.0% margin). Order book stood at ₹22,681 crore on 30 September 2026, including a new ₹5,700 crore Gujarat transmission LoI. Management said consolidated operating cash flow was negative in H1, which it attributed to HAM billing timing.

segments.name: Roads & Highways
segments.commentary: About 55% of the ₹22,681 crore order book. New wins include five NH-913 packages in Arunachal Pradesh worth ~₹3,128 crore over ~278 km, and Kolkata-area packages 11 and 12 worth ~₹4,050 crore that are now moving to execution.

segments.name: Transmission & Distribution
segments.commentary: About 21% of order book. New LoI from REC Power Development for a Gujarat 765 kV substation and ~300 km of lines, ~₹5,700 crore incl. GST, 36-month construction then 35-year O&M.

segments.name: Renewable energy
segments.commentary: About 16% of order book. Subsidiary commissioned 10 MW of a 147 MW solar plant in Maharashtra ahead of schedule. Management said renewables and transmission contributed ~₹143 crore of turnover this year, none last year.

segments.name: Metro and other
segments.commentary: Metro about 4% and industrial/other about 3% of order book.

segments.name: HAM assets
segments.commentary: Order book about 56% HAM per management Q&A. First HAM asset monetised; Bhatinda-Dabwali and Jalandhar-Shahbaz (Jalbeer Shahbaz) being prepared for monetisation. Jalandhar-Shahbaz achieved COD; Delhi-Saharanpur received completion certificate after quarter-end.

guidance_outlook: Management reiterated a minimum 15% growth guidance but said H1 growth already exceeded it; it did not formally revise the guidance.
Order inflow target for FY27 is ₹6,000 crore; management said ~₹5,400 crore is already achieved and it expects >₹10,000 crore of additional orders... (as stated in call, figure unclear).
Management said it targets a 25% project-level IRR on new projects across verticals.
Monetisation of HAM assets expected to bring ~₹250 crore inflow and reduce debt by ~₹540 crore; Bhatinda-Dabwali targeted for the current quarter.
Equity requirement for the HAM portfolio ~₹2,632 crore (as stated); ~₹1,962 crore pending, with ~₹770 crore in H2 FY27, ~₹730 crore next year and ~₹397 crore the year after, per management.
Gujarat transmission project targeted to start before 31 March 2027, which management called aggressive.
capex_capacity: 10 MW commissioned of a 147 MW solar plant in Maharashtra, ahead of schedule.
MP solar project: land and PPA in place; transmission line contractor being finalised, so start this year is uncertain.
HAM equity infusion progressing: ~₹669 crore already infused (figure as stated in call, unclear), with ~₹161 crore infused in Q1-Q2 FY27 per the later Q&A.
Gujarat 765 kV transmission project (₹5,700 crore) under LoI; 36-month construction period.
demand_pricing: Management said order book comprises 18 EPC, 10 HAM, 1 DBFOT and 10 tariff-based projects.
Management said it does not face a constraint on order wins given its 11 verticals across 16 states.
Management said it has executed Himalayan terrain projects (Ramban-Banihal tunnel, 6.5 km completed) and expects to replicate this in Arunachal Pradesh.
Management said it is not looking to add to the order book beyond ~₹6,000 crore inflow target this year; not a pricing discussion in the call.

qa_highlights.question: Guidance: H1 growth and 13.4% margin look strong versus the ~15% growth guidance. Will guidance be revised?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said guidance remains at a minimum 15% growth and margin guidance is unchanged; it said it aims to overachieve and prefers to be conservative.

qa_highlights.question: Timing and cash inflows from HAM monetisation and equity requirement?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said ~₹250 crore inflow and ~₹540 crore debt reduction are expected, with Bhatinda-Dabwali targeted this quarter. Equity infusion of ~₹1,962 crore pending, with ~₹770 crore in H2 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Order book conversion and execution trajectory across EPC, HAM and tariff projects?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said HAM is ~56% of the order book, EPC/HAM/tariff mix as stated; it did not give a revenue conversion timeline.

qa_highlights.question: Why was consolidated operating cash flow negative in H1 despite profit growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed it to HAM billing: only ~40% of payments received from NHAI in the half; it expects full-year cash flow to look different.

qa_highlights.question: Which segments drove consolidated revenue growth of 27% and H2 execution outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said renewables contributed ~₹143 crore of turnover, absent last year, alongside transmission; it expects continued contribution from both.

risks_watch: Negative H1 operating cash flow driven by HAM billing timing; watch for full-year conversion.
HAM equity requirement (~₹1,962 crore pending) and monetisation timing (~₹250 crore inflow, ~₹540 crore debt reduction).
Gujarat transmission project start targeted before 31 March 2027, which management itself called aggressive.
MP solar project delayed by transmission contractor selection.
Consolidated debt figure in transcript is garbled (730 vs 1,730 crore); verify against filings.
Management's responses on the order inflow target and some numbers were unclear in the transcript; verify before relying on them.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth and margin delivery, with a stated preference for conservative guidance and overachievement. Answers on HAM equity, monetisation and cash flow were less precise, and the transcript quality makes several figures unreliable.
key_quotes: And we will always be little conservative on this and it's always better for the investor to see the surprises.
So for Seagull what matters is we need to build projects at 25% IRR.

financial_highlights.value: Standalone ~₹436 crore; consolidated ~₹1,730 crore (transcript figure garbled, stated as 730 then 1730)

adds.what: 10 MW of a 147 MW solar plant in Maharashtra (subsidiary), commissioned ahead of schedule
Gujarat 765 kV substation and ~300 km transmission lines (REC Power Development LoI, ~₹5,700 crore incl. GST, 36-month build)

growth.why: Management reiterated minimum 15% FY27 revenue growth (H1 already ahead, guidance not formally revised), backed by a ₹22,681 crore order book and ~₹5,400 crore of the ₹6,000 crore FY27 inflow target already won; capacity additions are limited to a 10 MW solar tranche and the ₹5,700 crore Gujarat LoI, with no utilisation figure given.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Standalone EBITDA margin rose to 13.4% in Q2 from 11.7% (H1 13.4% vs 11.5%), and consolidated margin to 17.0% from 14.1%, with management holding margin guidance unchanged rather than cutting it.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Only a 10 MW tranche of a 147 MW Maharashtra solar plant is commissioned and the 765 kV Gujarat project (~₹5,700 crore, 36-month build) targets start before 31 March 2027, which management called aggressive; no utilisation figure was given.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management reiterated minimum 15% FY27 revenue growth with H1 already at 16.9% standalone and 21.1% consolidated, backed by a ₹22,681 crore order book and ~₹5,400 crore of the ₹6,000 crore FY27 inflow target already won.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management kept guidance at a minimum 15% growth and did not formally revise it despite H1 running ahead, saying it prefers to be conservative and overachieve.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Negative H1 consolidated operating cash flow tied to only ~40% of NHAI payments received, and ~₹1,962 crore of HAM equity still pending (~₹770 crore in H2 FY27), so cash-linked execution could slip.

rows.label: Gujarat 765 kV transmission LoI (~₹5,700 crore)
rows.why: A ₹5,700 crore REC Power Development LoI is in hand with 36-month construction then 35-year O&M, though management called the before-31-March-2027 start aggressive.

rows.label: HAM monetisation and debt reduction
rows.why: Management expects ~₹250 crore inflow and ~₹540 crore debt reduction, with Bhatinda-Dabwali targeted this quarter, after Jalandhar-Shahbaz achieved COD and Delhi-Saharanpur received completion certificate.

rows.label: H1 operating cash flow conversion
rows.why: Consolidated operating cash flow was negative in H1 because only ~40% of NHAI payments were received, and management expects the full year to look different, so collections should improve in H2.

tone.note: Management was confident on growth, margin delivery and the order book, but was less precise on HAM equity, monetisation and H1 cash flow, and did not revise guidance; analysts pressed on whether guidance would be raised given H1 strength.
